# Nexora Solution

> Nexora Solution is a Pakistan-based software company. Its cloud business platform, Nexora, provides POS, CRM and ERP modules for restaurants, retail stores, pharmacies, schools, transport fleets and growing businesses, with PKR billing and Urdu/English support.

Key facts:
- Plans: 1-month free trial (no credit card), Basic PKR 2,000/month, Standard PKR 5,999/month, Enterprise custom-priced. Yearly billing saves 20%. New users get 50% off their first subscription.
- Restaurant POS is available as a web app and a Windows desktop app with offline billing.
- Contact: WhatsApp +92 319 4329754, support@nexorasolution.online

## Products
- [Restaurant POS](https://nexorasolution.online/restaurant-pos/): billing, KOT, tables, kitchen display and reports for restaurants
- [Retail POS](https://nexorasolution.online/retail-pos/): billing, inventory and supplier management for retail stores
- [Pharmacy POS](https://nexorasolution.online/pharmacy-pos/): pharmacy billing, medicine batches and expiry tracking
- [School ERP](https://nexorasolution.online/school-erp/): students, fees, attendance, exams and parent communication
- [Nexora CRM](https://nexorasolution.online/crm/): leads, customers, deals, follow-ups and invoices
- [WhatsApp CRM](https://nexorasolution.online/whatsapp-crm/): WhatsApp lead capture, team inbox and follow-ups
- [Fleet & Rental](https://nexorasolution.online/transport-fleet/): fleet, rental bookings, customer ledgers and dues
- [Nexora AI](https://nexorasolution.online/ai/): AI features across the platform
- [Download Restaurant POS for Windows](https://nexorasolution.online/download/restaurant-pos/)
